blocks.text: Glenn Close paused and leaned back before accepting her first Oscar statuette from her old friend John Malkovich, as if she wanted to prolong the moment. When she took it, she gazed down at it as if it were her child. The award may have been honorary, but it was clear that to her, it was no empty gesture. Close, 79, whose eight Oscar nominations without a win tie her for the record, received the career achievement Oscar at the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences Governors Awards in Los Angeles on Sunday night.
